title: Binance Will Open Spot Grid Trading for ARKM/USDT, PEPE/USDT, USTC/USDT & WLD/USDT Trading Pairs, and Delist Selected Spot Grid Trading Pairs
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, 	 Binance will be opening spot grid trading services for the ARKM/USDT, PEPE/USDT, USTC/USDT and WLD/USDT trading pairs at  2023-08-08 10:00 (UTC) . In addition,   Binance will terminate spot grid trading services for the following trading pairs at  2023-08-11 10:00 (UTC) . ALICE/BTC ANKR/BNB ANT/BNB ARPA/ETH BAKE/BNB BEL/BNB BETA/BNB BNX/BTC BSW/BNB CHR/ETH DAR/BNB DASH/ETH DENT/ETH DEXE/ETH DGB/BUSD FLM/BTC FRONT/BTC HARD/BNB HIFI/ETH IDEX/BNB IMX/BNB LPT/BNB LPT/BTC LQTY/BTC LRC/BNB LSK/ETH LTO/BTC MANA/ETH MBOX/BNB MOVR/BTC MOVR/BUSD MTL/ETH NEO/ETH NKN/BTC OM/BTC OSMO/BTC POLS/BTC POLYX/BTC QKC/ETH QTUM/ETH RARE/BTC ROSE/ETH SCRT/ETH SLP/ETH THETA/BNB THETA/ETH UMA/BTC WAVES/ETH ZEN/ETH ZIL/ETH Please note: Users can still trade the above assets on other spot grid trading pairs that are available on Binance. At  2023-08-11 10:00 (UTC) , Binance will cancel all pending orders on the aforementioned spot grid trading pairs, and terminate spot grid trading services for these pairs in accordance with all applicable Binance terms and conditions, including but not limited to the  Binance Terms of Use .  Users are strongly advised to close and/or cancel the relevant spot grid trading bots prior to the cessation of spot grid trading services. Binance will not be responsible for any potential losses.  Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, this English version shall prevail.
